meta.title: Terminal + App Runner Module
meta.author: Harshit Sharma
meta.note: Wildcard subdomains not supported on Vercel free plan. Use Railway domain for previews.

overview.description: A cloud-based terminal module inside Code Shield that allows a user to connect a GitHub repo, install dependencies, and run their full-stack application — exposed at a public preview URL — all from inside the browser.
overview.scope: Scoped to Node.js/Next.js/Vite/Express based full-stack projects with Postgres databases
out_of_scope: Python, Ruby, Go, Rust runtimes (V2 consideration)

terminal_ui.purpose: Renders a real terminal in the browser. Same renderer used by VS Code.
terminal_ui.placement: New panel component inside Code Shield Next.js frontend

terminal_backend.purpose: Spawns a shell process and streams I/O over WebSocket
terminal_backend.hosting: Railway or Fly.io — NOT Vercel (needs persistent process)

framework_detection_result.name: string
framework_detection_result.hasDatabase: boolean (checks for prisma, drizzle, pg, mongoose in deps)

framework_detector_code.code: const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); function detectFramework(projectPath) { const pkgPath = path.join(projectPath, 'package.json'); if (!fs.existsSync(pkgPath)) return { name: 'Unknown', port: 3000, cmd: 'npm start', type: 'unknown', hasDatabase: false }; const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(pkgPath, 'utf-8')); const deps = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies }; const hasDatabase = !!(deps['prisma'] || deps['drizzle-orm'] || deps['pg'] || deps['mongoose'] || deps['@prisma/client']); if (deps['next'])          return { name: 'Next.js',   port: 3000, cmd: 'npm run dev',   type: 'fullstack', hasDatabase }; if (deps['vite'])          return { name: 'Vite',      port: 5173, cmd: 'npm run dev',   type: 'frontend',  hasDatabase }; if (deps['react-scripts']) return { name: 'CRA',       port: 3000, cmd: 'npm start',     type: 'frontend',  hasDatabase }; if (deps['nuxt'])          return { name: 'Nuxt',      port: 3000, cmd: 'npm run dev',   type: 'fullstack', hasDatabase }; if (deps['@sveltejs/kit']) return { name: 'SvelteKit', port: 5173, cmd: 'npm run dev',   type: 'fullstack', hasDatabase }; if (deps['express'])       return { name: 'Express',   port: 5000, cmd: 'node index.js', type: 'backend',   hasDatabase }; if (deps['fastify'])       return { name: 'Fastify',   port: 3000, cmd: 'node index.js', type: 'backend',   hasDatabase }; if (deps['@nestjs/core'])  return { name: 'NestJS',    port: 3000, cmd: 'npm run start', type: 'backend',   hasDatabase }; return { name: 'Unknown', port: 3000, cmd: 'npm start', type: 'unknown', hasDatabase }; } module.exports = { detectFramework };

frontend_component_code.code: 'use client'; import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'; import { Terminal } from 'xterm'; import { FitAddon } from 'xterm-addon-fit'; import 'xterm/css/xterm.css'; export default function TerminalPanel({ sessionId }: { sessionId: string }) { const termRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); useEffect(() => { const term = new Terminal({ cursorBlink: true, theme: { background: '#0d0d0d', foreground: '#e5e5e5', cursor: '#ffffff' }, fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono, monospace', fontSize: 14 }); const fitAddon = new FitAddon(); term.loadAddon(fitAddon); if (termRef.current) { term.open(termRef.current); fitAddon.fit(); } const ws = new WebSocket(`wss://terminal-backend.up.railway.app/ws/${sessionId}`); ws.onmessage = (e) => term.write(e.data); term.onData((data) => { if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) ws.send(data); }); window.addEventListener('resize', () => fitAddon.fit()); return () => { term.dispose(); ws.close(); }; }, [sessionId]); return <div ref={termRef} style={{ width: '100%', height: '400px', background: '#0d0d0d', borderRadius: '8px' }} />; }

caddy_proxy_config.description: Dynamically generated per session. Reload with: caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile

neon_branching_code.description: Create isolated Neon DB branch per session
neon_branching_code.create_branch: async function createSessionDatabase(sessionId) { const res = await fetch(`https://console.neon.tech/api/v2/projects/${process.env.NEON_PROJECT_ID}/branches`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.NEON_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ branch: { name: `session-${sessionId}` }, endpoints: [{ type: 'read_write' }] }) }); const data = await res.json(); return data.connection_uris[0].connection_uri; }
neon_branching_code.delete_branch: async function deleteSessionDatabase(branchId) { await fetch(`https://console.neon.tech/api/v2/projects/${process.env.NEON_PROJECT_ID}/branches/${branchId}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.NEON_API_KEY}` } }); }

security.container_isolation: Each user session runs in a separate Railway service or Fly Machine. No shared filesystem between users.
security.env_var_handling: DATABASE_URL and other secrets injected at container start via environment variables. Never exposed to frontend.
security.session_auth: sessionId validated against userId on every WebSocket connection. Unauthorized connections rejected immediately.
security.repo_access: Only public GitHub repos supported in V1. Private repos require GitHub OAuth token — store encrypted, never log.
security.resource_limits: Each container capped at 512MB RAM and 0.5 vCPU to prevent abuse.
security.auto_kill: Sessions auto-terminated after 2 hours of inactivity to prevent resource leaks.
security.port_conflicts: Port assignment uses a registry. Ports 3000-4000 allocated sequentially per session. Conflicts checked before assignment.
security.input_sanitization: Raw shell input passed directly to the shell process. No sanitization needed — this is intentional (it's a real terminal). Security comes from container isolation.

container_crash.action: Show error in terminal UI: 'Session crashed. Click Restart to recover.'
container_crash.recovery: POST /api/sessions/{sessionId}/restart — respawns shell without destroying container

session_timeout.action: Auto-terminate session, delete Neon branch, show 'Session expired' in UI
session_timeout.prevention: WebSocket ping every 30 seconds from frontend keeps session alive

port_conflict.action: Increment port by 1 and retry up to 10 times

repo_clone_failure.action: Stream error to terminal: 'Failed to clone repo. Check URL and permissions.'

neon_branch_failure.action: Session continues without DB. Warn user: 'Database unavailable for this session.'
neon_branch_failure.retry: 3 retries with 2 second delay before giving up

npm_install_failure.detection: npm install exit code non-zero (streamed to terminal)
npm_install_failure.action: No special handling — user sees real npm error output in terminal and can debug manually
npm_install_failure.note: This is intentional — it's a real terminal, errors are part of the experience

known_constraints.reason: Requires persistent process. Vercel is serverless.
known_constraints.solution: Terminal backend deployed as separate Railway service

known_constraints.constraint: Wildcard subdomains not on Vercel free plan
node_modules cannot persist across Railway deployments
known_constraints.reason: Railway containers are stateless by default
known_constraints.solution: npm install runs inside each session. Use Railway volumes for persistence (paid feature).

known_constraints.constraint: Only 10 Neon branches on free tier
known_constraints.solution: Strictly delete branches on session end. Enforce max 10 concurrent sessions.

known_constraints.constraint: Windows local dev requires terminal shell
known_constraints.reason: Process spawning depends on local environment
known_constraints.solution: Already installed. Railway Linux containers use bash automatically.
